methodology.capture_mean_ape: 100*abs(mean matched-cell prediction-actual)/actual, nonzero actual loads only; captured repeats receive equal weights
methodology.cell_mae_rmse: Computed on all matched per-cell errors; distinct from absolute bias of a capture mean. Pooled RMSE differs from averaging capture RMSEs.
methodology.dispersion: Population variance (g^2), IQR (g), MAD (g), and CV=100*population SD/abs(mean). Capture-level metrics averaged at each unique load before counting better/tied/worse; no Min-Max scaling.
methodology.scope: FSR2 main results, FSR1 appendix procedure replication on a second layer of the same module. Neither cross-module generalization nor between-module calibration transfer established.
methodology.plateau: Uses frozen forward/inverse knots without fitting or changing endpoint anchoring.

table_definitions.accuracy_weighting: Equal weight per saved capture; the 140 g FSR2 captures each receive one weight. APE excludes the zero-load capture (FSR2 n=20; FSR1 n=19); mass error columns include it (FSR2 n=21; FSR1 n=20).
table_definitions.mean_cell_mae: Mean of each capture's per-cell MAE, equal to pooled cell MAE because the same fixed cell count is used in every capture.
table_definitions.mean_cell_rmse: Arithmetic mean of each capture's per-cell RMSE; not the pooled RMSE, which is also recorded in evidence.json.
table_definitions.across_load_sd: SD in the headline APE descriptive distribution is across captures at different loads, not a repeatability error bar. Within-load SD exists only for repeated captures; n=1 gives null.
table_definitions.generated_tex: Contains only tabular bodies; captions must state the definitions and denominators above.

shared_lut.definition: Average the 256 training RAW ADC values at each load, then apply the same PAVA and inverse-LUT construction; not the mean of 256 inverse functions
shared_lut.prediction_rule: Apply the one shared ADC-to-g LUT separately to each validation cell, then clamp predictions to [0,U]; preserve nonfinite RAW as NaN
shared_lut.aggregation_rule: Any summary is computed after per-cell prediction, never by predicting the mean validation RAW first
